prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer: The first was **Gateway Arch National Park** in Missouri, established on **February 22, 2018**. The Trail Blazers’ only playoff-series victory with LaMarcus Aldridge was their **2014 first-round win over the Houston Rockets**, completed on **May 2, 2014**.
